card.situation:
Solicitation R4-PR-Cabo Rojo NWR-126204A4CI0 is a janitorial services contract at Cabo Rojo National Wildlife Refuge, Puerto Rico, issued by U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service (INTERIOR), unrestricted, evaluated Best Value / Trade Off.
It reached the owner because Red Cedar Facility Services is an exact NAICS 561720 match with multiple federal janitorial past-performance records and WOSB/EDWOSB eligibility, but the site is ~2,000+ miles from the firm's Oklahoma City base.
reasons_for: NAICS 561720 exact match and small-business size standard ($22M) are fully satisfied, and three qualifying federal/state janitorial references are immediately available [23123dbc-ef2873c4-p2-b1f3c919; 23123dbc-ef2873c4-p5-5a036359].

CIMS-GB certification, CMMS-logged QC inspections, and OSHA 30 supervisors directly support the QCP, professional-standards, and OSHA 29 CFR 1910.141 requirements [23123dbc-d1ab2780-p2-bf2bb22e; 23123dbc-d1ab2780-p1-7224df30].

Established green cleaning program satisfies the environmentally compliant and non-toxic/low-odor supplies requirements without additional investment [23123dbc-ef2873c4-p4-4fc72b11; 23123dbc-d1ab2780-p5-32063a02].
reasons_against: Cabo Rojo NWR (Puerto Rico) is ~2,000+ miles from Oklahoma City, directly violating the firm's 200-mile operating rule, and no Puerto Rico workforce or mobilization capability is stated in the profile [profile: rc-distance 200-mile rule; gap: 23123dbc-d1ab2780-p2-f8de56a3].

No local workforce exists to guarantee uninterrupted performance, and accurate Puerto Rico pricing (travel, logistics, local labor) cannot be established from the firm's cost basis, making a competitive and compliant price schedule highly uncertain [23123dbc-d1ab2780-p2-f8de56a3; 23123dbc-c8115174-p2-824b084b].

Multiple unknown compliance items — SAM.gov active registration, background-check program, contract manager designation, IPP electronic invoicing, and anti-trafficking plan — remain unconfirmed in the profile and would need to be resolved in under 4 days [23123dbc-ef2873c4-p4-11bd4c88; 23123dbc-d1ab2780-p3-f216b14c; 23123dbc-ef2873c4-p14-c5f931c8; 23123dbc-ef2873c4-p29-4a2d087c].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) operating under NAICS 561720 (Janitorial Services), well within the $22M small-business size standard.

We provide comprehensive non-personal janitorial and custodial services for federal and state facilities, furnishing all personnel, supplies, equipment, and supervision required for uninterrupted performance. Our service lines include daily and periodic cleaning, restroom sanitation, consumable restocking, floor care, and window cleaning — all performed to professional commercial janitorial standards and in full compliance with OSHA 29 CFR 1910.141.

Our quality assurance framework is built around a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) that logs every inspection, deficiency, and corrective action — directly supporting the Quality Control Plan requirement in this PWS. All field supervisors hold OSHA 30 certification, ensuring rigorous PPE enforcement and safety compliance on every shift.

Red Cedar's established green cleaning program ensures that all chemical products used on-site are non-toxic, low-odor, and environmentally preferred, satisfying the EPA-compliant chemical handling and environmentally compliant supplies requirements of this solicitation.

Our workforce of 38 direct W-2 employees — not temporary or 1099 labor — reflects the stable, continuous staffing model the Government requires. We hold CIMS-GB certification, demonstrating adherence to industry-recognized janitorial management standards.

We are prepared to submit a minimum of three past-performance references for same or similar federal and state janitorial work upon request.

Red Cedar Facility Services respectfully requests the opportunity to support the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service at Cabo Rojo National Wildlife Refuge.
questions_for_co: Workforce mobilization — The PWS requires the contractor to maintain an adequate workforce for uninterrupted performance at all times [23123dbc-d1ab2780-p2-f8de56a3]. Will the Government consider offerors who propose to recruit and hire locally in Puerto Rico prior to the period of performance start date, and if so, is there a minimum lead time between award and the first required service day?

Background check standard — The PWS states that contractor personnel must have a background check at the time of proposal submission [23123dbc-d1ab2780-p3-f216b14c]. Please clarify: (a) what type or level of background check is required (e.g., NACI, e-Verify, state criminal), (b) whether this applies to proposed key personnel only or all anticipated employees, and (c) which agency or office administers the check.

Contract manager availability and time zone — The PWS requires the contract manager or alternate to be available 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., Monday through Friday [23123dbc-d1ab2780-p4-e6023f31]. Please confirm whether those hours are Atlantic Standard Time (AST, Puerto Rico) or another time zone, and whether remote availability (phone/email) satisfies this requirement.

Electronic payment platform — The solicitation references electronic submission of payment requests [23123dbc-ef2873c4-p14-c5f931c8]. Please confirm the specific platform required (e.g., IPP — Invoice Processing Platform) and whether first-time users must register prior to proposal submission or prior to first invoice.

Anti-trafficking compliance plan — The solicitation references a contractor compliance plan appropriate to the contract [23123dbc-ef2873c4-p29-4a2d087c]. Please confirm whether a written FAR 52.222-50 anti-trafficking compliance plan must be submitted with the proposal or only maintained during performance, and whether a template or minimum content standard is provided.

Period of performance and option years — The solicitation does not specify the base period length or number of option years in the documents reviewed. Please confirm the base period start date, duration, and the number and length of any option periods so that offerors can provide complete pricing for all years on the attached price schedule [23123dbc-c8115174-p2-824b084b].
